
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Can-daydayup/p/19524089" title="发布于 2026-01-23 21:26">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">微软官方出品的 AI 初学者入门精品课程，21节课程教你构建生成式人工智能应用所需掌握的知识！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>前言</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>在人工智能浪潮席卷全球的当下，生成式 AI 正以前所未有的速度重塑着各个行业。为助力初学者快速踏入这一前沿领域，微软官方精心打造了这门 AI 初学者入门精品课程：<strong>Generative AI for Beginners</strong><span>。</span></span></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>课程介绍</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Generative AI for Beginners 课程包含 21 节干货满满的课时，从基础概念到实践应用，全方位、系统性地传授构建生成式人工智能应用所需掌握的核心知识。内容涵盖大语言模型原理、提示工程、RAG、<span>AI Agent、图像生成、负责任 AI、安全与用户体验等关键主题，并提供 Python 与 TypeScript 双语言代码示例，帮助学习者边学边练。</span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202601/1336199-20260123212311002-367538399.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>支持多语言</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>本课程支持以下 50 多种语言：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202601/1336199-20260123212329756-382307235.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>生成式人工智能初学者（Python 与 TypeScript版）课程列表</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>通过微软云布道者的21节全面课程，学习构建生成式人工智能应用的基础知识。</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>生成式人工智能初学者（Python 与 TypeScript版）：</strong>&nbsp;<strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"><a href="https://github.com/microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">https://github.com/microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners</span></a></span></strong></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202601/1336199-20260123212359545-472226933.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202601/1336199-20260123212404769-1773736247.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>面向初学者的生成式 AI 视频教程：</strong>&nbsp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"><strong><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/shows/generative-ai-for-beginners/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/shows/generative-ai-for-beginners</span></a></strong></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202601/1336199-20260123212435040-1738581881.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>生成式人工智能初学者（.NET版）</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>实用课程教你如何在.NET 中构建生成式人工智能应用。</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>生成式人工智能初学者（.NET版）：</strong>&nbsp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"><strong><a href="https://github.com/microsoft/Generative-AI-for-beginners-dotnet" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">https://github.com/microsoft/Generative-AI-for-beginners-dotnet</span></a></strong></span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202601/1336199-20260123212455556-965444622.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202601/1336199-20260123212502745-1919709043.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>AI实战从入门到精通</span></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"><a href="https://github.com/YSGStudyHards/DotNetGuide" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">https://github.com/YSGStudyHards/DotNetGuide</span></a></span></strong></li>
</ul>
